source: Explicit synthetic variations of examples/jee-parallel-lens-v19.json. No source question is interpreted or graded.
gap: The v19 ideal-lens Beam contract refuses an aperture downstream of the lens. These are raw native research runs only.
method: Compile canonical v19 Beam, ideal lens and downstream detector. Add only the existing compiled finite Aperture to a raw clone. Observe actual source starts, lens incidents and outgoing geometry, native isAbsorbed arm callbacks, and detector points. No hand-routed rays. On safe lens-hit controls compare sorted native sections to independent y_at_plane = y_at_lens * (1 - signed_distance/f).
qualification: A positive research witness requires all samples meeting the lens, completed native execution, zero warnings/errors/truncation/undefined, cross-section agreement to 1e-6 mm, and all four aperture endpoints farther than 0.1 mm from the projected actual outgoing section. Boundary, partial-lens, stopped and truncated scenes are retained without positive witness. No public schema, image detection, continuous transmitted power, 3D visibility or diffraction.
